answer: In a proof-of-stake agent economy, nodes stake collateral to participate in game-theoretic multi-agent auditing. To resist Sybils, random audit committees run topological cut verifications across the trust graph. If an auditor fabricates identity clusters, like an artificial opal pool or meadow farm bounded by a willow cluster, cross-verifiers detect bottleneck cuts and trigger stake slashing. This forces superlinear attacker cost scaling with network size.
